item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] ‘Everything is ruined’: Oldsmar apartment fire leaves 7 families displaced
item.description: The fire broke out just before 8:50 a.m. at the Aventine at Forest Lakes Apartment Homes. Flames spread through the attic and through the roof before firefighters brought it under control.
